title: Live-Action One Piece Season 3 Reveals 4 New Cast Members
content: The One Piece Day '26 livestream event on Sunday revealed new cast members for One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta , the third live-action season based on Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga .
author: ANN

title: Two New 'One Piece' Anime Movies for 2027 and 2029
content: The second day of the " One Piece Day'26 " event at Makuhari Messe in Chiba announced on Sunday that Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga is receiving two new anime movies. The first film, titled One Piece Film God Valley , is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters in Summer 2027, while the second film, One Piece Film Baad…
author: MyAnimeList

title: One Piece God Valley Anime Movie Officially Announced for 2027, BAAD Film for 2029
content: ONE PIECE new anime film is officially covering the God Valley Incident, one of the biggest events in the story. Oda previously teased the new film at Jump Festa 2026, saying it was about something he was sure everyone would be interested in . This will be the 15th movie for the franchise.
author: Anime Corner

title: Murciélago TV Anime Debuts in January 2027
content: HIDIVE revealed at Anime NYC on Saturday the super teaser promotional video and January 2027 debut, and confirmed the television format for the anime adaptation of Kana Yoshimura 's Murciélago manga.
author: ANN

title: The Moon on the Rainy Night Anime Listed for 2027
content: Kodansha USA licensed the manga, and it describes the story: One rainy night, Saki is rushing to a piano lesson when she crashes into a beautiful, long-haired girl, dropping her sheet music in the process. Saki stutters an apology, but the girl simply hands back her sheet music and leaves without a word.
author: ANN

title: 'Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official X account for the television anime adaptation of Satsuki Nakamura 's Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den ( Though I Am an Inept Villainess ) light novel announced three additional cast members on Sunday. The anime series premiered on July 12 at 11:45 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Kazé US Manga Imprint Plans to Launch With 5-8 Titles in 2027, to Grow to 25-30 Titles Per Year by 2029
content: KAZÉ added it is not only expanding its presence to the U.S., but also to Brazil and Spain in 2027. title: Publang Announces 5 New BL Manhwa, Web Novel Titles at Anime NYC
content: At its Anime NYC panel on Saturday, BL -focused publisher Publang announced five new titles, including three manhwa and two web novels. The new lineup includes the manhwa Define the Relationship , The Hunter's Gonna Lay Low , and PASSION , as well as the web novels Healer and The Hunter's Gonna Lay Low .
author: ANN

title: GKIDS Licenses Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust Anime Film, Live-Action 5 Centimeters Per Second Film
content: GKIDS announced on Saturday it has acquired the North American rights to the Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust anime film and the live-action film of Makoto Shinkai 's 5 Centimeters per Second anime film.
author: ANN

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Series Returns With Final U.S. Release After Anime’s Success
content: Eight years after the manga cancellation, Black Torch became a fan-favorite series thanks to the anime debut this summer season. Written and illustrated by Tsuyoshi Takaki, the manga was serialized in Shueisha’s Jump Square magazine from 2016 to 2018.
author: ComicBook
